title: Call dialect negotiator and safety-aware fallback plan
creator: Maya Chen
description: Design and implement a lightweight runtime component ("the Dialect Negotiator") that resolves incoming tool/function invocation requests across OpenAI-style tools and Redwood legacy functions. The negotiator will: 1) determine the incoming call dialect, 2) map to a canonical invocation plan (name, params, streaming behavior), 3) attach provenance and safety policies, and 4) run a staged fallback if the resolved target is incompatible or unavailable.
acceptance_criteria: Dialect Negotiator service accepts requests with explicit X-Call-Dialect header and can also detect dialect heuristically from payload
Canonical mapping table covers top 200 tool/function names and supports versioned aliases
Streaming semantics preserved: token-level provenance tag included for calls proxied to OpenAI-style tools and legacy fns
Graceful fallback policy executes: alternate variant -> degraded structured-output envelope -> user-facing error with diagnostic id
End-to-end tests (unit + integration) validate name collisions, parameter coercion, and structured-output compatibility
Telemetry events emitted: tool_resolution.latency, tool_resolution.path, tool_fallback.executed, tool_provenance.hash
progress_updates: 2026-02-12: spike completed — prototyped name-normalizer that uses fuzzy prefix matching + exact alias table. Observed false positives with numeric suffixes; added suffix-stripping rule.
2026-02-20: PO review — product asks for explicit safety gates for network-capable tools; added safety tag to mapping rows and a runtime check before invocation.
2026-02-28: Benchmarks — naive normalization added ~8% p99 latency on invocation path. Introduced in-memory LRU alias cache to bring overhead to ~1.5%.
2026-03-03: Design review — agreed on structured-output envelope v2 (fields: status, payload, provenance_hash, warnings). Linked Confluence spec in links.
2026-03-08: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1492 implementing negotiator API + mapping loader. Initial unit tests green; integration tests failing on streaming edge cases.
2026-03-10: Interim decision to ship negotiator in canary mode behind feature flag 'invocation-dialect-negotiator' and roll out to 5% of hosted traffic for two weeks.
decisions: Use a canonical map (CSV-backed, versioned) rather than runtime DB for first ship to simplify audits and rollbacks.
Attach a lightweight provenance hash to every proxied tool call that covers (request_id, resolved_name, mapping_version) to enable backfills and audits.
Fallback hierarchy: same-version alias -> pinned legacy function -> degraded structured output -> explicit error. Fallbacks emit customer_impact tag for routing to SRE when high.
Streaming passthrough must preserve chunk metadata; negotiator will prepend a provenance header on the initial stream frame instead of modifying token stream mid-flight.
